title: Maugre
html_source:
Term from the 14th c. meaning “notwithstanding” or “in spite of”.

Etymology (wiktionary):
From Middle English, from Anglo-Norman malgré, from mal (“bad”) + gre (“pleasure", “grace”) (from Old French, from Latin gratum)
